quests), abyss_entry (8, the Abyss entry quests of both races) and silentera_canyon (11); levels 25-53. Branch `lane-c/p6-q07`, stacked on

### Held back (2): the enter-world timer packet of 1044 and 2042

The first gate run with all 64 failed 17 of 19 gates (all but travel and ascension) at the level-ready burst of a new character: three
SM_QUEST_ACTION where the gates expect one (the prologue's start; tests/scenario/PrologueSupport.cpp `expectPrologueStarted`, and the
level-ready sequences of m5a to m5g). `abyss_entry/_1044TestingFlightSkills` and `_2042TheLastCheckpoint` register an enter-world hook
that calls `QuestService.questTimerEnd(env)` unconditionally (`_1044TestingFlightSkills.java:172-175`, `_2042TheLastCheckpoint.java:
167-170`), and Java's questTimerEnd sends `SM_QUEST_ACTION(questId, 0)` to the player whatever his quest state (QuestService.java:841-847);
QuestEngine runs every registered enter-world hook for every player, so each new character of either race gets two more packets.
This is Java-faithful traffic, which the owner's rule of 2026-09-29 would let the gates learn; but it changes the level-ready (and every
enter-world) expectation of 17 gates and PrologueSupport, most of them lanes A and B's, so the two files are held back instead, as Q10's
enter-world files were (p6q-ascension-route.md §8.3), and the gate change is left as a proposal: teach the gates' enter-world bursts the
two timer-end SM_QUEST_ACTIONs (quest 1044 and 2042, action 0), then land the two files. They are questgen's bytes, at parity, and passed
their golden cases before the hold-back.

### Gate impact

With 1044 and 2042 held back, none expected, so no traffic was measured: no gate goes to Beshmundir or Silentera Canyon, and the levels start at 25 (the gates'
characters are at level 20 or below). The abyss_entry quests name two gate npcs, Jucleas (203752, Sanctum) and Balder (204075,
Pandaemonium), as talk registrations of 1920/1921 and 2945/2946; each dialog hook returns false at once without its quest state
(`if (qs == null) return false;`, `_1920TestingYourMettle.java`, `_1921TheAbyssQuiz.java`, `_2945HoningYourSkills.java`,
`_2946AbyssGeneralKnowledge.java`), and their level hooks need level 25. **Gates** (the 62): 19 of 19 passed, one at a time with the lock per gate (5,482 s); "Loaded 4978 quest handlers" (4916 + 62); no "QE: exception" line.
